name: Dioses Menores
source:
Xavi has a very unusual pet shop: among parrots, sacks of feed and accessories for pets, you can also find a group of creatures that only vaguely resemble normal pets. They are minor gods, imprisoned in Xavi's shop until their faults expire.

[Translated from [url=https://ertal-games.itch.io/dioses-menores]Itch.io[/url]]
